src/5d/catalog-id.ts.name: Napplet catalog ID
src/5d/catalog-id.ts.description: Gives each verified napplet a stable ID scoped to its publisher and kind, or to the event itself for snapshots.

src/5d/errors.ts.name: Load failure reasons
src/5d/errors.ts.description: Defines the error and its fixed codes, such as bad signature or hash mismatch, so callers can refuse a napplet cleanly.

src/5d/index.ts.name: Napplet resolver
src/5d/index.ts.description: Checks a manifest's signature, reads its tags, downloads the app by hash from Blossom servers and returns verified HTML.

src/5d/kinds.ts.name: Manifest event kinds
src/5d/kinds.ts.description: Lists the three manifest event kinds: snapshot (5129), root (15129) and named (35129).
